description: Alpha Agent Stage 6 historical backfill — ISOLATED pre-2015 (2009-2014) price window for the Stage 12 independent-time confirmatory study. Writes ONLY under a dedicated pre-2015 ingestion tree so the released 2015+ MARKET_BAR tree, Stage 11 caches and released Stage 12 artifacts are byte-untouched. date_range is strictly clipped to 2009-01-01..2014-12-31 (zero post-2014 bars). ACQUISITION + READINESS only via Norgate local; never creates orders, fills, signals, trade decisions, model promotions, portfolio/paper-book/Paper-Trader DB changes, Daily Close triggers or prediction-service calls; never installs a package; never upgrades norgatedata; operational ledgers are read-only; available_at is preserved as observed and never fabricated; a fiscal period-end is never substituted for a public-availability date. Contains NO secret.
